feature.name: Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0

notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Squirrel.
description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing another Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Chatterfang abilities, causing any number of target creatures to get +1/-1 until end of turn any number of times.
notes: If you control additional Squirrels, you can sacrifice them as well to get infinite Treasure tokens.

notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

feature.name: Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0

notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
Apply the Academy Manufactor replacement effect then apply Chatterfang's, creating a Treasure token, a Food token, a Clue token and three 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily high amount of life, you may repeat the loop without sacrificing Treasure or Food tokens, amassing infinite tokens of each variety.
You may also activate Chatterfang any number of times to reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

feature.name: Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0

description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing a Squirrel.
Because the Squirrel is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating five 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens, a Food, a Clue and a Treasure token
Resolve the Chatterfang ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
notes: You can target Ygra with Chatterfang's ability infinitely. Since it gets +2/+2 each loop, it won't die from its toughness reduction.

Choose to return Prossh to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobold or Squirrel, adding {1}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

Repeat from step 2.
